conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: A feedback loop is when the effect of an action circles back to influence the original cause, creating a continuous cycle. For example, a thermostat sensing a room's temperature (effect) turns the heater on or off (cause) to maintain a set temperature.
